name: Rein Maychaelson
bio:
Rein Maychaelson is an Indonesian film director and screenwriter.  Rein attended Universitas Multimedia Nusantara, majoring in film. He directed many short films such as Udin Telekomsel (2015), A Dinner with Astronaut (2016), and Errorist of Seasons (2017). He also directed the web-series Neo Batavia (2018).

His films are already recognized in more than 25 national and international film festivals, which includes Jogja-NETPAC Asian Film Festival, XXI Short Film Festival, San Francisco Indonesian Film Festival, Los Angeles Indonesia Film Festival, Bangkok International Film Festival, Europe on Screen, Viddsee Jurree Award, etc.

credits.title: The New Messiah, Who Found His Own Truth
credits.overview: 30 years ago, a child was born of a virgin woman and drew followers who believed he was the new messiah from the moment of his birth. But twenty-six years later, on her deathbed, his mother revealed a painful truth: he is not divine, but instead a bastard born of a hidden affair.

credits.title: Sammi, Who Can Detach His Body Parts
credits.overview: Sammi has the ability to remove parts of his body and give them to those he loves and wants to help. After his death, Sammi’s mother goes in search of the pieces of her son.

credits.title: The Rootless Bloom
credits.overview: In the midst of their parents' separation, sisters Cindy and Jena are forced to choose between which parent to go with, and consider the consequences of each choice.
